generate_additive_triple: generate additive triples of given sizes using a torch operation and return ArithmeticSharedTensors
generate_binary_triple: generate xor triples of given size and return BinarySharedTensors for MPC protocols
square: generate a square double of given size and return the value and its square as ArithmeticSharedTensors
wrap_rng: generate a random shared tensor and its wrap count for arithmetic secret sharing across parties
B2A_rng: generate a random bit tensor shared as both arithmetic and binary shared tensors for conversion
